record.field: -- the confirmed orders, by vendor ; a "[label](url)" cell is a link to Odoo SELECT '[' || "partner_id" || '](' || :odoo_url || '/odoo/res.partner/' || CAST("partner_id_" AS VARCHAR) || ')' AS "Vendor", COUNT(*) AS "Orders", SUM("amount_untaxed") AS "Untaxed" FROM d WHERE "state" IN ('purchase', 'done') GROUP BY "partner_id", "partner_id_" -- the vendor breaks the ties : a stable order ORDER BY "Untaxed" DESC, "partner_id" LIMIT 10
